column2: WARNING Station Battery Link Removal Sign – Tool Can Bridge Live Battery Terminals – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Tool Can Bridge Live Battery Terminals. This WARNING Station Battery Link Removal sign from CGAP Safety reads: STATION BATTERY LINK REMOVAL / TOOL CAN BRIDGE LIVE TERMINALS / REMOVE METAL JEWELRY / USE INSULATED BATTERY TOOLS. Written for electric utility substations, transmission control houses, power plant battery rooms.

Why this sign matters

A metal tool or jewelry can bridge live battery terminals when a cell link is removed, causing a short circuit, arc and burns even though the bank is DC.

Where to post it

On the battery rack end rail or room wall directly beside the station battery bank, at eye level.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance technicians and relay and DC systems crews.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.333; NFPA 70E; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
